npc.alexander.stdmod_1: Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alexander.stdmod_2: I'm selling runes, life rings, wands, rods and crystal balls. I also buy powerful spellbooks. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_1: Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_2: Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_3: Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_4: Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_5: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_6: Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_7: If you need general {equipment}, just ask me for a {trade}. I can also provide you with some general {hints} about the game.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_8: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_9: I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_10: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_11: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_12: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_13: If you want to challenge monsters in the {dungeons}, you need some {weapons} and {armor} from the local {merchants}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_14: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_15: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_16: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_17: Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_18: One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_20: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_21: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_22: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_23: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_24: I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_25: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_26: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_27: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_28: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_29: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_30: The monk {Cipfried} takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_31: As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_32: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_33: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_34: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_35: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_36: No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_37: I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_38: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_39: He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_40: Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_41: He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_43: Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_45: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_46: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_47: He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_48: If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_49: He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_50: She's currently recovering from her travels in the {academy}. It's always nice to chat with her!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_51: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_52: Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_53: She sells health {potions} and antidote potions. Also, she buys {blueberries} and {cookies} in case you find any.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_54: This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_55: This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with {premium} adventurers though.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_56: She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_57: Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_58: Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_60: Sorry, I am looking for a SMALL axe.

npc.alkestios.stdmod_1: Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_2: We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_3: We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_4: We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_5: I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_6: It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
npc.alternative_rock.stdmod_1: Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.alternative_rock.stdmod_2: Find the Golden Anchor and click there, after talk with Navigator.
npc.amanda.stdmod_1: Well, I would do it myself but I can't leave town for a longer time. Would you be so kind to bring me a vial of holy water from the White Raven Monastery?
npc.amanda.stdmod_2: I thank you a lot in advance. The power of the holy water from the White Raven Monastery is legendary. For my task it is indispensable. We talk about that when you get back.
npc.amanda.stdmod_3: It's your decision. I will ask the next believing mind that visits the temple of Banor's blood.
npc.amanda.stdmod_4: Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!

npc.amanda.stdmod_14: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_15: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.amanda.stdmod_16: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.amanda.stdmod_18: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_19: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_20: A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.

npc.anerui.stdmod_1: I am the mistress of the hunt. At this place you may buy the food our hunts provide.
npc.anerui.stdmod_2: Hunting is an art, practiced too often by diletantes. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
npc.anerui.stdmod_3: Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunters' best friends. In the northeast of the town one of us may sell such tools.
npc.anerui.stdmod_4: Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
npc.anerui.stdmod_5: Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
npc.anerui.stdmod_6: Watch the sky, it will tell you.
npc.anerui.stdmod_7: I guess it's a human god for the human sight of nature. I have not much knowledge of this entity.
npc.anerui.stdmod_8: If they ever existed they are gone now.
npc.anerui.stdmod_9: The Kuridai are too agressive not only to people but also to the enviroment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
npc.anerui.stdmod_10: The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
npc.anerui.stdmod_11: We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature, may they be living or unliving.
npc.anerui.stdmod_12: The humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to the orcs then to us.
npc.anerui.stdmod_13: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_14: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_15: I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
npc.anerui.stdmod_16: That is the race to which I belong.
npc.anerui.stdmod_17: The magic they wield is all that matters to them.
npc.aneus.stdmod_1: It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
npc.aneus.stdmod_2: The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the WORKS on the city.
npc.aneus.stdmod_3: The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
npc.aneus.stdmod_4: The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!
npc.archery.stdmod_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery.stdmod_2: I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Archery's Hut. I am also {selling} ammunitions.
npc.archery_rook.stdmod_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery_rook.stdmod_2: I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Archery's Hut. I am also {selling} ammunitions.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_1: ...the arithmetical paradox has the same value in a metaphysical way, then...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_2: Oh my! Alverus!! Did you really...?!?! I have to recalculate it to make sure that I made no mistake.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_4: ...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_5: ...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_6: Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_7: How dare you asking me this?!? I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the HEADMASTER of this academy!!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_8: I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the headmaster of this academy.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_9: I have better things to do than helping you. See that ice statue over there? My dear friend Alverus needs to be revived!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_10: Time is an illusion and completely irrelevant to me.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_11: Weapons are for those people who aren't able to use their heads or better what's INSIDE their heads. No offence <coughs>.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_12: Yeye, I believe you almost feel like home among all those brainless creatures!
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_1: 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_2: Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_5: Manny kinds of. Like {Mesh Kaha Rogh'}, {Za'Kalortith}, {Uth'Byth}, {Uth'Morc}, {Uth'Amon}, {Uth'Maer}, {Uth'Doon}, and {Zatragil}.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_6: Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_7: It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_8: It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_9: Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_10: Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_11: Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_12: Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_13: Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_14: Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_15: One day I'll go and look.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_16: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_17: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_18: I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_19: You shut up. Me not want to hear.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_20: Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_21: Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_22: Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_23: Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_24: They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_25: Me not fight them, they not fight me.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_26: Me wish I could make weapon like it.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_27: Me people not live here much. Most are far away.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_1: My name is now known only to the wind and it shall remain like this until I will return to my kin.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_2: I was a guardian of this glade. I am the last one... everyone had to leave.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_3: This glade's time is growing short if nothing will be done soon.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_5: Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_3: Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_4: They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_6: It's a fine library, isn't it?
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_7: I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_9: Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_10: These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_12: I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_13: Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_14: Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_15: Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_16: The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_18: Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_19: Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_20: You pitiful two-eyed creatures. In our eyes, you look weird. It is pathetic how much you depend on hands and legs. Since we bonelords have more eyes than any creature in the world, it is obvious that you can determine the value of a species by the number of its eyes.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_21: Our race is very old. Over the time, we have been given many different names by other races. The term bonelord sticks to us for quite a while now. In our language the name of our race is not fix but a complex formula, and as such it always changes for the subjective viewer.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_22: Our language is beyond comprehension by your lesser beings. It heavily relies on mathemagic. Your brain is not suited for the mathemagical processing necessary to understand our language.To decipher even our most basic texts, it would need a genius that can calculate numbers within seconds in his brain.
